objective: To supplement the financial needs of landholding farmers' families for procuring agricultural inputs and meeting domestic needs.
benefit: Rs. 6000 per annum per family in three equal instalments of Rs. 2000 every four months.
eligibility: All landholding farmers' families having cultivable land in their names are eligible, subject to exclusions.
exclusions: Farmer families with one or more members belonging to the specified excluded categories.
Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
Former and present Ministers and specified elected representatives.
Serving or retired government officers and employees, subject to stated exceptions.
Superannuated or retired pensioners receiving Rs. 10000 or more per month, subject to stated exceptions.
Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year.
Specified professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects.
